comparison.objective: Close a used needle's safety guard one-handed against a fixed block, then discard the syringe in a sharps container; body and specs are absent.
comparison.physical_skill: One-handed guarded latching against a fixture and hazardous-object disposal, not bimanual hammer-and-mandrel use.
comparison.success_condition: Guard is closed and syringe is contained in the sharps bin; latch and containment thresholds are unavailable.
comparison.reason: Safety-latch actuation and whole-syringe disposal differ from notch fracture and millimetre-scale fragment search.
